summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for restructuring CloudCraft into a 13-Module Coursera AWS Cloud Practitioner curriculum (130 levels total, 10 per module with Graded Module Assessments, all modules unlocked), redesigning the level intro into a swipeable 3-step Cardboard-Cutout Diorama Storyboard with minimal text and zero clipping, and implementing run-time AWS zone physics validation plus idle/wasted compute spend diagnostics.
